passes.name: inventory-pass
passes.detail: Android and Go expose the same 27 stable semantic route keys across six primary domains.

passes.name: identity-pass
passes.detail: File/package/manifest/operation identities travel with entity routes; missing/stale identities have typed failures.

passes.name: layout-pass
passes.detail: Compact and wide shells select the same semantic route; layout only changes bottom-bar versus rail chrome.

passes.name: deep-link-pass
passes.detail: Android ACTION_VIEW and Go translation accept nested dustui:// routes; encoded file paths round-trip without slash loss.

passes.name: retirement-pass
passes.detail: Production source no longer contains DustDestination, DustShellNavigation, ToolsHubScreen, or a peer Debug workbench destination.

passes.name: system-pass
passes.detail: System is decomposed into runtime/modules/automation/diagnostics/certification/settings; Activity owns durable run/evidence identities.
